$$

## Test cases


```{r}
#| eval: false
#| label: test case

# rows in sim dataset
n <- 500
# size of RE groups
n_re <- 2
# x1 slope
b1 <- 1.5
# x2 slope
b2 <- -0.5
# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

  model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)
  glimpse(coef_df)
```


```{r}

#| eval: false
#| label: n_re = 2

# simulation setting

n <- 500 # rows in sim dataset

n_re <- 2 # size of RE groups

b1 <- 1.5 # x1 slope

b2 <- -0.5 # x2 slope

# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     )

# for loop

for(i in 1:500){
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

  model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)

  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]

  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]

  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]

  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$se_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3","Std. Error"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
}

```

```{r}
#| eval: false

acf_hist <- gf_histogram(~acfs, data = result)|>
  gf_labs(subtitle =  "frenquency of acfs at lag(1) for 500 simulated datasets and models") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), 
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)  
  )

ggsave(filename = "figures/acf_hist.png", plot = acf_hist, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  
```

# Different numbers of cases per random effect group

```{r}

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     n_re = rep(NA,n)  # number of Random Effect Group
                     )

# for loop

for(i in 1:n){
  
  if(i < n/5){
    n_re <- 2
  } else if(i < 2*n/5){
    n_re <- 4
  } else if(i < 3*n/5){
    n_re <- 8
  } else if(i < 4*n/5){
    n_re <- 16
  } else {
    n_re <- 32
  }
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

  model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
  
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)
  
  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]
  
  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]
  
  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]
  
  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$se_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3","Std. Error"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
  result$n_re[i] <- n_re
}
```

```{r}
result <- result |>
  mutate(n_re = as.factor(n_re))
```

```{r}
n_re_hist <- gf_histogram(~acfs|n_re, data = result)+
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), 
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)  
  )

ggsave(filename = "figures/n_re_hist.png", plot = n_re_hist, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```


```{r}
n_re_box <- gf_boxplot(acfs ~ n_re, fill = ~n_re, data = result)|>
  gf_labs(x = "numbers of cases per random effect group",
          y = "acf value of lag(1)")+
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), 
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)  
  )

ggsave(filename = "figures/n_re_box.png", plot = n_re_box, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

# Vary random effect standard deviation

```{r}
#| label: Vary random effect st dev.

# simulation setting

n <- 500 # rows in sim dataset

n_re <- 2 # size of RE groups

b1 <- 1.5 # x1 slope

b2 <- -0.5 # x2 slope

# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     group_sd = rep(NA,n)
                     )

# for loop

for(i in 1:500){
  
  if(i < n/5){
    group_sd <- 0.1
    
  } else if(i < 2*n/5){
    group_sd <- 0.25
  } else if(i < 3*n/5){
    group_sd <- 1
  } else if(i < 4*n/5){
    group_sd <- 2
  } else {
    group_sd <- 4
  }
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

  model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)

  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]

  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]

  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]

  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$se_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3","Std. Error"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
  result$group_sd[i] <- group_sd
  
}

result <- result |>
  mutate(group_sd = as.factor(group_sd))
```

```{r}
re_sd_box <- gf_boxplot(acfs ~ group_sd, fill = ~group_sd, data = result)|>
  gf_labs(x = "random effect standard deviation",
          y = "acf value of lag(1)")+
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), 
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)  
  )

ggsave(filename = "figures/re_sd_box.png", plot = re_sd_box, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

# Compare models with and without the RE

```{r}

# simulation setting

n <- 500 # rows in sim dataset

n_re <- 2 # size of RE groups

b1 <- 1.5 # x1 slope

b2 <- -0.5 # x2 slope

# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5

# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     re = rep(NA, n) # whether it has random effect
                     )


# for loop

for(i in 1:500){
  
# simulate data
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

# model
  
    if(i < n/2){
    result$re[i] <- "random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    
  } else {
    result$re[i] <- "no random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = sim_data)
  }
  

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)

  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]

  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]

  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]

  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$se_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3","Std. Error"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
}

glimpse(result)
```

  )
